instruction.text: Match the singular subject and object pronouns with one another.
Match the plural subject and object pronouns with one another.
Jess and Pam are camping together. Listen to their conversation and fill in the correct object pronouns.

atoms.b: Good morning, Jess! How are you feeling today?
Tired! All that rustling in the woods did not let ((++me you)) fall asleep. What about you?
I am doing spectacular! I just finished making some tea for ((++us them)). Would you like some?
Don’t mind if I do! When did we want to meet with Patrick and Julian?
We wanted to meet up with ((++them us)) around noon at the lake.
Cool! Do you know if Patrick has his camera with ((++him them))?
Probably. There are so many beautiful views out here. It would be weird if he didn’t take ((++it him)) with him.
Perfect. I’ll start packing our things. I’ll let ((++you her)) know when I’m done.

instruction.text: Read and select the correct answer.

atoms.a: Object pronouns are the more passive parts in the sentence: they receive the action rather than performing it. What else is true of an object pronoun?
b: ++ They are pronouns that come after the verb in a sentence.
They are pronouns that come before the verb in a sentence.
They are pronouns that always come before and after the verb in a sentence.
